title: Crüger to Müller, Palm Sunday 1628
author: Peter Crüger
summary: Having seen the *Rudolphine Tables* announced in the Frankfurt catalogue, Crüger orders a copy and confesses a great longing for them.

notes.on: the more uncertain Severin leaves me
notes.note: Longomontanus, whose *Astronomia Danica* (1622) Crüger had hoped would settle the matter.
